before.source: const action = async (sha256: string, download: boolean) => { setBusy(true); setError(''); try { const result = await api.call<FilePreview>(download ? 'content.attachment.download' : 'content.attachment.preview', { projectId, contentId: item.id, sha256 }); if (!download) setPreview(result); } catch (error: any) { setError(error.message); } finally { setBusy(false); } };

after.source: const action = async (sha256: string, download: boolean) => { setBusy(true); setError(''); const operation = (download ? '下载附件' : '预览附件') + '「' + (item.attachments?.find(file => file.sha256 === sha256)?.name || '当前附件') + '」'; try { const result = await api.call<FilePreview>(download ? 'content.attachment.download' : 'content.attachment.preview', { projectId, contentId: item.id, sha256 }); if (!download) setPreview(result); } catch (error: any) { setError(operation + '：' + uiErrorMessage(error, { domain: 'central', operation }).replace(/^执行此操作[:：]\s*/, '')); } finally { setBusy(false); } };
